critical_code_review_comments: routes/analysis.py::climb_leaderboard — clusters attempts by start-point haversine gap (<300 m) AND relative length delta (<0.45). Correctly excludes clusters with <2 attempts (out.append gated on len(atts) >= 2). Attempts sorted by (None-first, time_s) so a rider missing a time never becomes PR. PR flag is set on best-time attempt only (a['time_s'] == best); gap_s is 0 for PR and (t - best) for the rest. Sort clusters by -count so most-repeated climb tops the list.

routes/analysis.py::form_target — has_event:false path is short-circuit safe (no CTL/ATL walk if no event, so no 500 risk from an empty daily-TSS history). If event_date exists but is unparseable it also returns has_event:false. days_out<0 (past event) returns {past:true} without projecting. Projection uses the same ka/kb kernels as the historical PMC walk, seeded from today's ctl/atl, so it's consistent with /analysis/pmc?forecast_days=….

routes/analysis.py::put_event — payload with {event_date:null, event_name:null} correctly clears the settings doc for that rider (upsert set-to-null), which is what the /clear button relies on. GET returns {event_date:null, event_name:null} after clearing, and form-target sees ed=None and returns has_event:false.

routes/coach.py::coach_weekly_note — caches per ISO-week+coach in udb.settings.id='weekly_note' under key note_<coach_lower>; returns cached:true when cache.week == now.strftime('%G-W%V'). refresh=True bypasses cache. JSON coercion strips accidental code fences with raw.strip('`') and finds outermost braces — resilient to LLM emitting ```json fences. has_activity is computed from this_wk['rides'] > 0.

frontend/app/climbs.tsx — friendly empty state shows a compass icon, 'No repeated climbs yet' heading and helpful CTA. When has_data:true, first climb auto-opens (setOpen(d.climbs[0].id) in useEffect). PR row shows 'Personal best' label, trophy icon in yellow rank badge and yellow time colour. Non-PR row shows +mm:ss gap in dim colour. Tapping an attempt routes to /activity/{activity_id}.

frontend/app/fitness.tsx — parallel Promise.all fetches PMC/records/digest/form-target so first paint is fast; weekly-note is fetched separately with its own noteLoading gate so LLM latency doesn't block the rest of the screen. ShareCardModal builds AchievementCardData from digest (kicker/title/subtitle/stats) — correctly guards on digest presence.
